title: Onsite to Remote Handoff and Internal Mobility Checklist
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, tactical playbook for when an employee transitions from an onsite role to a remote role (temporary or permanent), or when a candidate is converted via internal mobility. It combines manager checklists, IT/hardware steps, security and compliance gating, and a short buddy/mentor micro-rotation template.

Scope and assumptions:
- Applies to full-time hires and transfers moving from office-first to remote-first in any Redwood region.
- Not for international relocations that require HR immigration support (see HR relocation playbook).
- Assumes existing HR ticket created (HR intake) and manager has approved remote working pattern.

Quick overview (10-step canonical flow):
1) Confirm remote-eligibility: manager verifies role, team SLA, and customer-facing constraints (if any).
2) Internal mobility acceptance note: candidate and manager sign mobility acceptance doc (template link in linked_artifacts).
3) Security & compliance pre-check: SRE/Security review for access patterns, data sensitivity.
4) Hardware inventory & request: IT ship/prepare laptop + peripherals, coordinate pickup if local.
5) Network & account setup: VPN, 2FA, identity groups aligned to new team.
6) First-week schedule: manager creates Day0-Day7 calendar with async windows for timezone differences.
7) Buddy pairing and micro-rotation: 3-day knowledge transfer plan with 2-hour daily syncs.
8) Access handoff & audits: list of tools to deprovision or reassign for the previous onsite role.
9) Checkpoint reviews: Day7, Day30, Day90 with manager and people-ops.
10) Close mobility ticket: HR confirms payroll/location update and final assets shipped/received.

Manager checklist (pre-acceptance):
- Document remote justification: expected hours overlap, oncall changes, latency needs.
- Confirm performance metrics that will be used to measure early success (OKRs or squad KPIs).
- Flag any customer or compliance constraints to Security and People Ops.

Manager checklist (T-minus 7 days):
- Add new hire/transfer to team calendar and shared folders.
- Create a 7-day sequenced onboarding plan (start-of-day async note + 2 x 30m check-ins on Days 1–3).
- Nominate a buddy and a short-term mentor (different people if possible).
- Add to relevant Slack channels and specify timezone working hours in profile.

IT / Hardware runbook (People Ops ops + IT):
- Verify current asset ownership and shipping address. If shipping is required, use preferred vendor and include return labels for old device.
- Standard kit for remote-converted staff: laptop, power brick, headset, webcam, spare dongles, and local power adapter. For roles requiring GPUs or special hardware, file a capex request.
- Test remote provisioning remotely: enroll device in MDM, verify VPN/SSO, confirm 2FA, check access to essential repos and docs.
- If user keeps an onsite machine, mark it as shared and update inventory tags.

Security & compliance gating:
- Security to review whether the role will access regulated data (PII/PHI/CC) and require additional controls (HSM/KMS keys, restricted S3 buckets, VPC egress rules).
- Required steps for sensitive access: background of manager sign-off, completed L2 security checklist, and a short threat-model note attached to the mobility ticket.
- Device encryption and disk-lock policy must be enforced before final approval.

Buddy / Micro-rotation template (3 days):
Day 0 (pre-work): read sprint docs, architecture overview, repo list, and ops runbook.
Day 1: 2hr sync (context + codebase tour), 1hr pairing on a small, safe task; end-of-day async summary.
Day 2: 2hr pairing on feature or infra task, introduce to oncall runbook; end-of-day doc update.
Day 3: Shadow a customer- or infra-facing incident drill (if applicable), handover of a small ownership area.

Access & deprovisioning checklist (previous onsite role):
- Revoke physical desk keys/badge privileges, or mark badge as remote-only in access system.
- Reassign shared accounts, mailing lists, and calendar ownership the day before final transition.
- Transfer any outstanding booking responsibilities (meeting rooms, recurring dinners).

First week (Day 0–7) sample agenda (remote-friendly):
- Day 0: Welcome packet + async introductions + hardware confirmation.
- Day 1: Org orientation (recorded) + manager 1:1 + team standup attendance.
- Day 2: Buddy pairing + small onboarding task.
- Day 3: Product deep-dive + cross-team intro.
- Day 4: Security + SRE briefing (if role touches infra).
- Day 5: First-week retro + goals and measurements for the next 30 days.

30/90 day check-ins and success signals:
- Day 7: Manager confirms access, buddy feedback, and immediate blockers.
- Day 30: 30-day goals review; is the new hire contributing to planned deliverables?
- Day 90: Full onboarding retro: product outcomes, cross-team relationships, escalation readiness.
- Metrics to consider: number of pull requests merged, incidents participated in, meetings owned, customer touchpoints executed.

Common edge cases and mitigations:
- Timezone >8 hours: expand async onboarding artifacts and schedule overlapping office hours twice weekly.
- Hardware lost in transit: IT to expedite replacement shipping and issue a temporary VPN-only access policy.
- Short-term remote (3 months): track office-return date and re-provision badges as temporary; include check-in at 45 days.

Templates and examples (quick snippets):
- Acceptance note subject line: "Internal Mobility Acceptance — ROLE — Effective YYYY-MM-DD"
- Manager Day 7 check-in template: bullet list items (access, blockers, knowledge gaps, buddy rating 1–5).
- Buddy feedback form: 5 quick questions (communication, autonomy, knowledge uptake, engagement, blockers).

Open questions / TODOs (for people-ops team):
- Add a clear SLA (in hours) for hardware shipping by region — current variance is large.
- Decide whether remote hires should receive a local meetup stipend in first 90 days (pilot vs permanent).
- Update payroll location flow for employees who change tax jurisdiction mid-quarter.

Notes to self / working items (marisol):
- Drafted this as a pragmatic checklist; want to convert to a short Form + automation flow in GSheet/HRIS.
- Follow up with Security on the sensitive access checklist (linked Jira HR-982).

Appendix: quick checklist (copy/paste for tickets)
- [ ] Remote eligibility confirmed by manager
- [ ] Mobility acceptance signed
- [ ] Security pre-check completed
- [ ] IT asset request created and shipped
- [ ] VPN/SSO/2FA verified
- [ ] Buddy assigned and 3-day micro-rotation scheduled
- [ ] Access reassignments/deprovisions completed
- [ ] Day7/Day30/Day90 check-ins scheduled

End of document.
